section.howItWorks.title: How a pairing becomes a credit
section.howItWorks.subtitle: The flow is the same Maher uses every day. Three steps, one credit.
section.howItWorks.step1.title: Trade on Binance or RedotPay
section.howItWorks.step1.body: Buy USDT with your local currency (3% fee), then sell the same amount at a higher price — your profit is roughly 10% of capital.
section.howItWorks.step2.title: Upload your two screenshots
section.howItWorks.step2.body: Add the buy and sell screenshots to your wallet with the amounts and date. The system auto-pairs them.
section.howItWorks.step3.title: Earn 1 credit · Level up
section.howItWorks.step3.body: Once verified, you bank 1 credit and your level progresses. Level 4 unlocks the 2030B internal P2P.
